articles.title: 'Go to Pakistan': Dipke on those doing Hindu-Muslim 'divisive' politics
articles.description: Abhijeet Dipke led a large protest in Mumbai demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Thousands of supporters gathered at Shivaji Park, despite police denying permission for the event. The Cockroach Janta Party aims to address electoral roll irregularities and the Election Commission's functioning. Dipke emphasized the importance of Hindu-Muslim unity during his speech at the protest.

articles.title: Watch: Hindu temple in US attacked with bricks, windows shattered
articles.description: An attack on the Shree Swaminarayan Vadtal Dham Hindu Mandir in Richmond Heights occurred while devotees were present. The incident involved bricks being thrown at the temple, resulting in shattered windows. Surveillance footage is being reviewed by authorities to identify the perpetrator. This potential hate crime coincides with Hindu Heritage Month and upcoming Navratri celebrations.

articles.title: China tells families of AI executives to get permission before travelling abroad
articles.description: China is implementing expanded travel restrictions on senior professionals in the AI and semiconductor sectors. Family members, including spouses and children, may now require government approval for overseas travel. These measures aim to prevent the outflow of sensitive technology, information, and talent. The restrictions specifically target private-sector talent critical to China's technological ambitions. This policy reflects wider concerns over losing important expertise to other countries during global competition.

articles.title: UPI transactions rise 27% to 145 billion in H1 FY27 ahead of new MDR
articles.description: UPI has recorded significant transaction growth, processing 145 billion transactions in the first half of the financial year. The value of these transactions increased to Rs 177 lakh crore, reflecting a notable rise. A new merchant discount rate will be introduced on October 15, applying to high-value UPI transactions. Most everyday merchant transactions will remain free, with certain services facing a flat fee structure.

articles.title: G7’s 100-million-barrel diesel fix: What happens after the emergency release
articles.description: The G7 announced an urgent release of 100 million barrels of oil and fuel products to counteract the ongoing diesel shortages, starting now and extending over the upcoming four months. Yet, experts warn that this withdrawal from emergency reserves could jeopardize future preparedness. Additionally, with supply routes still facing disruptions from geopolitical issues, the overall impact on fuel pricing and market dynamics remains ambiguous.

articles.title: Irdai plan to help check mis-selling, raise returns
articles.description: Irdai has introduced proposed guidelines aimed at reshaping the commission and expense structures for insurance distribution. This shift focuses on reducing reliance on high commission models, favoring a more customer-oriented strategy. Key proposals include imposing limits on commissions for products and introducing remuneration based on distributors' efforts. This pivotal change could greatly affect brokers and online platforms, with shares already experiencing a decline.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Sonali Kulkarni celebrates ‘The Paradise’ success as Nani’s film crosses Rs 100 crore in India
articles.description: Nani and Srikanth Odela's action thriller 'The Paradise' has reached a remarkable milestone, grossing Rs 100 crore in India. To celebrate, actress Sonali Kulkarni cut a cake, expressing her gratitude to the audience. Although the film's box office performance dipped due to mixed reviews, it has persevered, amassing a total worldwide gross of Rs 162 crore. The plot centers around the Savaari tribe's fight for legal citizenship in the 1980s.

articles.title: Oscar buzz grows for ‘Godzilla’ ahead of ‘Ramayana’ clash
articles.description: Takashi Yamazaki's film 'Godzilla Minus Zero' has received strong praise and a high Rotten Tomatoes score. It follows the award-winning 'Godzilla Minus One' which won an Oscar for Best Visual Effects. The film is anticipated to compete for the Best Picture nomination at the Academy Awards. Both 'Godzilla Minus Zero' and Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana' are set to release on November 6.
